definitions.gloss: delivery slip; packing slip; delivery note
definitions.explanation: A document that accompanies delivered goods, listing the items, quantities, and other details of the shipment.

examples.japanese: {納品書|のうひんしょ}と{商品|しょうひん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the delivery slip against the products.

examples.japanese: {納品書|のうひんしょ}に{記載|きさい}された{数量|すうりょう}と{合|あ}っていますか。
examples.english: Does it match the quantity listed on the delivery slip?

examples.japanese: {納品書|のうひんしょ}は{経理|けいり}{部|ぶ}に{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the delivery slip to the accounting department.

notes:
BUSINESS DOCUMENT FLOW:
1. {見積書|みつもりしょ} (quotation)
2. {注文書|ちゅうもんしょ} (purchase order)
3. {納品書|のうひんしょ} (delivery slip)
4. {請求書|せいきゅうしょ} (invoice)
5. {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} (receipt)

CONTENTS OF {納品書|のうひんしょ}:
- {品名|ひんめい} (product name)
- {数量|すうりょう} (quantity)
- {単価|たんか} (unit price)
- {納品日|のうひんび} (delivery date)
